experiment_info.name: openness_informationflow_culturalregions
experiment_info.title: Joint Effects of Openness and Information Flow on Cultural Region Formation
experiment_info.description: This experiment investigates how varying levels of individual openness to new cultural traits and the spatial range of social interactions (information flow) jointly affect the emergence and number of distinct cultural regions in a simulated society.
experiment_info.research_question: How do combinations of individuals’ openness and spatial range of social interactions influence the number and size of distinct cultural regions that emerge over time?
